description: This PHP script is part of the SuiteCRM system, specifically for managing the upload folder. It verifies admin access, iterates through beans (modules), checks files in the upload directory, and removes orphaned files not linked to any bean. It also handles deletion of files marked as deleted within beans.

classes.name: DirectoryIterator
classes.description: Built-in PHP class used to iterate over filesystem directories.

methods.name: haveFiles
methods.description: Checks if the bean has associated files.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Creates a list query for fetching bean records based on file GUIDs.

methods.name: populateFromRow
methods.description: Populates bean properties from a database row.

methods.name: deleteFiles
methods.description: Deletes files associated with the bean.
